text:
laura_csm: Heads up 92 DovetailCo hitting an activation lull. New seats provisioned but daily active users down ~60% week-over-week. Risk: could lean into a downgrade at renewal. See account health: https://redwood.app/accounts/DOV-112
ryan_ae: rough numbers and renewal date?
laura_csm: Renewal in 38 days; only 2 active users vs 8 expected. Feature adoption low (embeddings + streaming). Billing page showed a spike in errors last week.
sam_onboard: I ran an onboarding session Fri 92 they flagged "confusing prompt routing" and didn't join office hours.
pete_support: We had a 504 on the inference endpoint 3 days ago, ticket #3145. Root cause mitigated but they saw it during a demo.
laura_csm: Proposed save plan: 1) immediate 30-min enablement + tailored playbook, 2) 60-day trial extension + usage credits, 3) downgrade-safe path preserving API keys & exports, 4) short feedback micro-survey after call.
ryan_ae: I'll join the call for exec reassurance. Can we schedule in next 48h?
laura_csm: Wed 10am PT works for me. @ryan_ae @sam_onboard can you join? @pete_support can you prep tech notes?
sam_onboard: Wed 10 ok. I'll prep a 15-min demo focusing on routing, prompts, and KV cache tips. Will bring a concise checklist: `Onboard Checklist: API keys, Default Workspace, Prompt Templates, KV Cache setup`
pete_support: I'll pull logs and prepare a 1-pager on the 504, what we fixed, and a temporary bypass route to reduce risk.
ops_bot: Created Jira task CS-3248 for DovetailCo save call 92 https://jira.redwood.com/browse/CS-3248
laura_csm: Outreach email draft to send now 92 SUBJECT: "Quick check-in + usage credits for DovetailCo" BODY: ```Hi <Name>,

We noticed a drop in activity and want to help. Can we grab 30 mins this week? We'll extend your trial and add credits to help you finish your eval. Book: <cal_link>

Thanks,
Laura (CS)``` Tweak away.
ryan_ae: +1. Add a line about data export/downgrade safety to ease product concerns.
laura_csm: Downgrade path notes for handoff: keep API keys active, provide export-ready CSV, no hard-delete for 30 days after downgrade. If they select Starter, preserve 500k tokens of historical KV for 60 days.
pete_support: Also recommend a fallback model variant (lower memory/CPU) we can route them to if capacity spikes cause errors.
sam_onboard: Post-call: short 3-question survey (usefulness, blockers resolved, next steps). Capture results in Gainsight, tag account DOV-112.
laura_csm: I'll own follow-ups & survey capture. Sam runs demo, Ryan on exec outreach, Pete on tech. Ops_bot, please set reminder tasks and follow-ups.
ryan_ae: Drafting outreach now, will paste copy here once ready.
laura_csm: Thanks team :pray: 92 keep updates minimal in this thread unless blockers pop up.
ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 3 days (CS-3248).
